item.title: Nasu Animal Kingdom: A Highland Wildlife Park for Families — Guide
item.description: Nasu Animal Kingdom is one of the largest and most popular family attractions in the Nasu Highlands, combining indoor and outdoor zones across a sprawling site that houses a wide range of animals from big cats to farmyard favourites. The park is known for its close-up encounter opportunities, including a petting zone with rabbits and small mammals, along with scheduled dog agility shows and bird-of-prey flight demonstrations that run throughout the day, making it a reliable full-day option for families visiting the highlands.
